$comment: Post list for the research blog, rendered at wilsonic.co/blog. The website fetches this file, so publishing a post is one PR here: add the markdown under docs/ and list it below with a unique slug. path is relative to the repository root. The site sorts newest-first by date.

posts.title: The Tunings That Ring
posts.description: I describe the open research program I run on Erv Wilson's scale designs, disclose the scoring function and the experiment queue in full, and ask for your help improving both.

posts.title: The Machine Keeps Deriving Wilson
posts.description: I tell three episodes in which exhaustive searches re-derived Erv Wilson's hand results, from the 1975 D'Alessandro template and its pitch-just addressing trick to the 1993 golden-generator table, with every number linked to its receipt.
